channel.title: Cuochi senza fuochi
channel.description: Bring one dish, meet fifteen neighbours. Cuochi senza fuochi is a free potluck dinner club in Padova for people who just moved here. No kitchen needed, no fee, come on your own.

item.title: The journey together
item.dc:creator: Cuochi senza fuochi
item.description:
Almost everybody in this photo had met for the first time about two hours earlier.

The venue is what we usually get: a borrowed common room, tables pushed where they fit, chairs dragged in from next door. The food is what people carried across town — a tray of pasta, grated carrot, something fried, a bowl of crackers to keep everyone going while the rest arrived. And a banana, for reasons nobody explained.

Nothing there needed an oven. Nobody spent more than about five euro. People stayed standing and talking long after the trays were empty, which is the part that matters.

This is what we mean when we say come alone. It is the normal way to arrive.
